title: Achievement
description: An achievement in the student's flight log (achievements/<slug>.yaml), shown as a mission patch. The website works out who has earned it from data the services already keep.

slug.description: Optional; must equal the file name.

how.description: What it takes to earn it — shown while not yet earned, so make it concrete ("Pass 10 graded labs").

order.description: Position in the flight log; earned ones come first.

code.description: The letters on the patch, like an airport code.

ticket.description: The patch: its code and colour.

kind.description: lessons_completed: different lessons finished, each once. updated_lessons_read: lessons finished again after their text changed, once per update. sections_completed / courses_completed: course parts or whole courses with every lesson done. labs_passed: graded labs passed with astrona submit. playgrounds_started: playgrounds launched (a renew is not a launch). playground_renews: astrona run renew used. lab_hours: counted lab time (a lab counts once it passes). playground_hours: counted playground time (ended with astrona destroy). cockpit_hours: counted lab and playground time together. mock_exams: mock exams finished, optionally narrowed by level, exam and passed. streak_days: best streak. program: every certification of a program held.

level.description: mock_exams only: runs at this level (mixed-level runs never count).

exam.description: mock_exams only: runs of this exam, by its file name under exams/ (cka, pca, ...).

passed.description: mock_exams only: true counts passed runs only.
